instruction: The document contains the closed rectangular curve named source_outline on Input. Make an outward planar offset of 6 mm in world XY, leaving source_outline completely unchanged (including ID and attributes). Name the resulting closed curve offset_outline and put it on the new Cut layer. Its world bounds should be (-6,-6,0) to (86,56,0) mm. Keep exactly the original and the offset curves; no other new layers or objects. Both curves must be visible and unlocked. Match bounds within 0.001 mm and perimeter/area within 1%.
